name: Balancer boosted linear-pool rounding
summary: AaveLinearPool rounded a crafted bb-a-USDC-to-USDC swap output to zero while still changing the pool's BPT balance. After the attacker reduced virtual supply close to zero, this accounting change inflated bb-a-USDC's rate; the nested bb-a-USD pool cached that rate and exchanged the overvalued BPT for bb-a-DAI and bb-a-USDT.
notes: The AaveLinearPoolFactory created this direct bb-a-USDC runtime, whose onSwap rounding logic is executed by the Vault during the exploit.

BlockSec reports more than $2.12 million stolen across the related boosted-pool attacks on several networks. The structured components reproduce $367,786.81 of proceeds in the Ethereum code-age anchor transaction, including the pre-transaction aUSDC rate, and provide an onchain cross-check for the reported campaign estimate.
